entries.title: Dracula
entries.creator: Bram Stoker
entries.gist: Count Dracula forces Mina Harker into a blood bond that leaves her telepathically linked to him; Van Helsing then hypnotizes her before dawn so she can report Dracula's movements.

entries.title: Trilby
entries.creator: George du Maurier
entries.gist: The musician and hypnotist Svengali puts the tone-deaf artist's model Trilby O'Ferrall under hypnosis and makes her a celebrated singer, 'La Svengali'; she cannot sing once his control ends.
entries.where: Later chapters (her career as 'La Svengali' and collapse after his death)
entries.wife: no (passed off as Svengali's partner; never legally married in the sources)

entries.title: The Avengers #200 (Ms. Marvel / Marcus)
entries.creator: Jim Shooter, David Michelinie, Bob Layton, George Pérez; Marvel
entries.gist: Marcus takes Carol Danvers (Ms. Marvel) to another dimension, rapes and impregnates her; commentators note the story implies he brainwashed her into 'loving' him, and she leaves with him.
entries.pregnant_end: yes — gives birth on Earth to a child who ages into Marcus
entries.note: Brainwashing is implied (critics' reading), so this is a loose fit.

entries.title: Alias (Jessica Jones vs. the Purple Man)
entries.creator: Brian Michael Bendis, Michael Gaydos
entries.gist: Zebediah Killgrave, the Purple Man, uses mind control to put Jessica Jones under his command for months, psychologically torturing her and forcing her into his schemes; she later breaks his control.
entries.pregnant_end: yes — pregnant by Luke Cage at the end of Alias #28
entries.kids_together: yes (with Luke Cage, after the control; daughter Danielle later)
